description: Union trades electrical sequence: PPE and verify-dead, read the schematic, bend conduit, land conductors, test and debrief. Mirrors the TradePath Electrical zone (same steps, same stations) so the learner can run it in the Holodeck. Simulation only — not certification, not licensure, not an apprenticeship credential.

halls.note: No hall mapped. Trade halls in the Holodeck player (per vr-entry README): Ironworkers, Welding Trades, Boilermakers, Millwrights. Hall mapping is open (Phase 4). The 111-hall roster in the SmartCiti.X bundle is an in-repo list; 0 of 111 signed off by a named practitioner — a named hall is not a partner.

sources: TradePath centre JSON — Electrical zone session + next-3 skills (Electrical Theory Fundamentals, Conduit Bending, Blueprint & Schematic Reading).

stations.title: Safety station — PPE, first aid, extinguisher
Panel board — distribution panel + conduit runs

steps.action: PPE check + verify the panel dead before touching it.
Read the schematic and identify each circuit on the panel.
steps.check: Every circuit named from the schematic.

steps.action: Measure, mark, and bend the conduit to the planned run.
steps.check: Bend matches the plan; no rework needed.

steps.action: Mount the panel and land conductors in schematic order.
Test, torque-check, and debrief with the coach.
